## NATIVE_CODEC variable

The in-process value codec.

**Signature:**

```typescript
NATIVE_CODEC: NativeCodec
```

## Remarks

Its prelude embeds the codec functions' source text, so the conversions that run inside the automation process are the same code that the package's unit tests exercise in Node. It implements every value plan kind except `file` and `file-source`<!-- -->, which fail with a codec error marked with the unsupported kind. References convert in identity form only, one object at a time, to a resource the app finds by its identifier, at the application or within a container that is itself in identity form; any other reference is marked unsupported as well.

Conversions follow the value contracts: integers are canonical decimal text within the safe-integer domain, numbers in dynamic content are always doubles, special double states and `-0` are explicit, dates are UTC text with millisecond precision, and RGB colors decode to the 16-bit channel list `[r, g, b]`<!-- -->.
